Definition: to dock off, i.e. curtail (transitive or intransitive, literal or figurative); especially to harvest (grass or grain)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to be short, be impatient, be vexed, be grieved; 1a) (Qal) to be short; 1b) (Piel) to shorten; 1c) (Hiphil) to shorten; 2) to reap, harvest; 2a) (Qal) to reap, harvest; 2b) (Hiphil) to reap, harvest
